verdict.rationale: Undermind is an AI research assistant, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this kind of product. However, all MCP evidence describes Undermind as an MCP server that other clients connect to (Cursor, VS Code, Claude, ChatGPT). Nothing shows Undermind itself connecting to or using external MCP servers' tools, and server-role evidence does not transfer to this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
